title: UNZA student celebration/march after student-union election
reason: Search-only report describes students escorted back to campus after student-union election celebration; no demand directed to Zambian government is reported, and the event appears electoral/celebratory rather than policy protest.
notes: Excerpt says police used tear smoke after students threw stones at officers. Do not treat that as evidence of repression against an eligible mass protest; no count or full report reviewed.
